newsitem.title: USA: Liggett to comply with Mass. disclosure law.
newsitem.headline: Liggett to comply with Mass. disclosure law.

text.p: Liggett Group Inc will fully comply with a Massachusetts law that requires tobacco companies to disclose the ingredients of their cigarettes to the state health department, the head of Liggett's parent company said on Thursday..

Bennett LeBow, chairman and chief executive of Brooke Group Ltd, testified at a public hearing that he would go as far as listing the ingredients of Liggett's cigarette brands on the side of their cartons.
"I strongly urge every other tobacco company to follow Liggett's lead," said LeBow, whose company is the only one to reach a settlement with the state attorneys general who are suing the industry.
